description: Sensitive information scanning rules for Phase 3 UI automation artifacts

pii_patterns.description: Personally identifiable information that must never appear in committed artifacts

credential_patterns.description: Credentials, tokens, and signing materials that must never appear in any artifact

signature_materials.description: Production signing and distribution materials — never in UI automation artifacts

fixture_data_rules.description: All test fixtures must use synthetic data
requirements: No real user data in any fixture
All images/audio/text must be synthetic or open-source test assets

enforcement.local: Agent must not write secrets to disk. Pre-flight check before any manifest write.
enforcement.ci: Automated scan of all PR artifacts. PR blocked on detection.
